publication: Alex Kruckman, Math 526 Lecture Notes: Stability and Categoricity, last updated April 26 2022; 83-page author-hosted PDF, printed page equals one-based PDF page.

reviews.checked_passages: Printed p.61 Theorem 6.15 and Definition 6.16; pp.65–67 Theorems 6.28–6.29, Corollary 6.30, Proposition 6.31 and Theorem 6.32 inspected for planning only.
reviews.consumers: Planning-only gap survey: arbitrary bases/dimension and generic types.
reviews.outcome: The elementary basis existence/cardinality and unique-generic type portions support ready continuations. The source treats a countable language and uses earlier rank/monster-model machinery in places; the proposed corpus scopes instead use existing elementary definitions. No Morley rank, total transcendence, uncountable categoricity or model-classification result is proposed for immediate adoption.
